# The 2026 Board

*Generated by `python -m scripts.build_board` (1500 sims, seed 20260807). Projections rescored to this league's 6-point passing TDs; replacement levels derived with FLEX allocated endogenously.*

## Replacement level

| pos | replacement pts | who that is |

| QB | 345.4 | Jaxson Dart |
| RB | 167.1 | Rhamondre Stevenson |
| WR | 163.6 | Marvin Harrison Jr. |
| TE | 138.5 | George Kittle |

FLEX slots are won by **10 RB, 10 WR, 0 TE** — no tight end outscores the marginal flex back or receiver, so TE stays a ten-starter position and its replacement sits ~28 points below RB/WR. That is the whole reason elite TE value is high here.
